keyword: why are we at war with iran
claims: As of April 2026, the U.S. and Israel are engaged in a major military conflict with Iran.
The military conflict is referred to as "Operation Epic Fury" and "Roaring Lion".
The conflict aims to preemptively destroy Iranian missile capabilities.
The conflict aims to degrade Iran's nuclear program.
The conflict aims to neutralize Iran's regional proxy networks.
The war aimed to eliminate alleged imminent threats.
The war aimed to promote regime change.

U.S. and Israeli officials argue they are acting to prevent Iran from developing nuclear weapons and delivering them via missiles, framing the actions as necessary self-defense to remove existential threats.
There was a 2025 attack on Iranian nuclear infrastructure.
Following a 2025 attack on Iranian nuclear infrastructure, allies claimed Iran was rebuilding its program.
The U.S. has targeted Iran-backed groups involved in decades-long hostilities.
Iran-backed groups carried out numerous attacks on U.S. personnel in Iraq and Syria.
U.S. and Israeli strikes on February 28, 2026 killed senior officials.
Iran responded to the U.S. and Israeli strikes on February 28, 2026 with missile attacks on regional allied targets.
Official goals focus on military degradation.
Some officials, including Israel's Prime Minister, have expressed a desire for the collapse of the Iranian theocracy.
The conflict has led to threats to target critical civilian infrastructure.
The conflict has led to disruptions to the Strait of Hormuz.
The Strait of Hormuz is a vital global energy route.
